mentions.name: Bitwise Cloud
mentions.description: A Claude Code plugin providing semantic search over embedded systems documentation. Its backend is being rewritten from Python to Go, using pure-Go embedding generation and vector search to avoid C/C++ ML dependencies like FAISS and ONNX Runtime in the build.
mentions.source_excerpt: Rewriting the backend Bitwise Cloud, my semantic search for embedded systems docs Claude Code plugin from Python to Go.
